findings.problem: Agent pushes widening W to claude/base and N (non-policy) on top to claude/w, opens PR claude/w -> claude/base: PR run diffs W..N, no widening, grants-widening and ci-ok green on N. Agent changes the PR base to main via API: no new run (edited not in types). N is up to date with main and has a green ci-ok from a pull_request run -> mergeable without the label. With a non-claude/** branch there is no red push run at all; with claude/** the PR run is the newer same-name check.
findings.required_improvement: In pull_request mode diff against main regardless of the PR base (merge-base of refs/remotes/origin/main and the PR head), or apply the no-label push rule when github.base_ref != main; add `edited` to types; test: PR event with non-main base and widening vs main -> red.

findings.where: scripts/ci/widening_gate.py:126-150 (head_arrival uses the earliest run; stale compares only with the latest force-push)
findings.problem: PR head B (widening) runs at 09:00; force-push to A at 09:30; owner labels A at 10:00; agent fast-forwards A -> B at 11:00 (no force-push event). Earliest run for B = 09:00 < label, last force-push 09:30 < label -> not stale, gate green on B with a label set on A. Reproduced with tests/ci FakeApi. Also: fork PR runs have empty pull_requests and pass the 'this PR' filter by branch name only.
findings.required_improvement: Arrival = earliest run for head SHA created after the latest head_ref_force_pushed event; also require head_repository.id == pr.head.repo.id; add the A/B/A/B test (must be red) and make sure mutmut kills mutants of stale().

findings.problem: Git resolves `origin/main` as refs/tags/origin/main before refs/remotes/origin/main, and actions/checkout fetch-depth 0 fetches tags. With a tag origin/main at the agent's head, push/dispatch runs print 'no widening against the merge-base with main' and pass (reproduced: rc 1 -> 0, git warns 'refname origin/main is ambiguous'). A green push/dispatch ci-ok then exists next to the red PR run on the head SHA.
findings.required_improvement: Use refs/remotes/origin/main explicitly (also in the fix for the first finding); test with a tag named origin/main -> red.

findings.problem: New DoD-4: Python mutation checks run with mutmut, self-written mutation scripts are not used. mutate_m2.py is a self-written list of 39 hand-picked (file, old, new) edits; 35 of them target Python (gxg_policy/diff.py, lint.py, bundle.py, cli.py, scripts/ci/widening_gate.py), where mutmut generates mutants systematically. Example of what the hand list misses: finding 2 (stale() ignores fast-forward to an older SHA) has no mutation and no test. The 39/39 result is reproduced, but it does not meet the new DoD-4. The requirement is newer than the code; the score is already capped at 5 by older findings.
